prompt:
Pixel-art character turnaround sheet for a monster in a Doom/Hexen-style first-person dark-fantasy dungeon game, where monsters are drawn as sprites seen from several camera angles: the KNIGHT, a slow, heavily armoured warrior behind a huge rune-carved metal tower shield. Spells splash off the shield, so the player must get behind it or close in with a sword.

REFERENCE IMAGES, in the order attached: turnaround sheets of two other monsters from the same game (a red imp, and a robed acolyte). Use them ONLY for the art style and the sheet layout: pixel size, outline weight, shading, how the views are arranged and how far each one is turned. Do not copy anything of their designs.

THE KNIGHT
- A broad, heavy humanoid figure in full fantasy plate armour, about a third taller than the imp would be beside it and a little taller than the acolyte, standing squarely with its feet apart, braced and still. Nothing of the body inside shows: it is armour from head to foot.
- Dark blackened steel plate with dull gunmetal highlights, battered and scratched, with a little rust in the seams. The plates are sculpted and angular, fantasy rather than historical: layered, spiked pauldrons, a ridged breastplate, flared gauntlets, armoured greaves and pointed sabatons.
- A closed HORNED HELM: two thick, dark horns curving out from its sides and up, ridged like a ram's or a bull's. A narrow eye slit, black inside except for two GLOWING EYES, cold pale blue, bright against the shadow.
- Below the breastplate, a skirt of overlapping steel plates (tassets) over dark chainmail. No tabard, surcoat or cloth hanging over the armour.
- A TOWER SHIELD on its LEFT arm, made entirely of metal: a tall rectangle with a gently curved face, as tall as the knight from its feet to the top of its helm (not counting the horns), and as wide as its shoulders. Thick dark steel with a raised, riveted rim and a heavy central ridge running top to bottom. Angular RUNES are carved into its face in columns, glowing faintly the same cold pale blue as the eyes. The bottom edge of the shield rests on the ground.
- In its RIGHT hand, a heavy flanged steel mace, held down at its side, its head hanging near the knee.
- No crosses, no religious symbols, no heraldry, no painted emblems anywhere.
- A muted, cold palette: blackened steel, gunmetal grey, a little rust brown, dark chainmail grey, and pale blue only for the eyes and the runes.

THE SHIELD IN EACH VIEW (this matters for the game: the shield covers the knight from the front)
- FRONT: the shield faces the viewer squarely and hides almost the whole body. Only the helm with its horns and glowing eye slit shows above it, a little of the right pauldron, the mace arm and the mace at the image-left edge of the shield, and the sabatons below it. The shield is held on the knight's left arm, so it is on the image-right side of the body's centre, but wide enough to cover the body.
- FRONT THREE-QUARTER: the shield, seen at an angle, still covers the knight's front; the horned helm, the right pauldron and the mace arm show beside it.
- SIDE (profile): the shield is seen edge-on, as a tall, thick steel slab held in front of the body on the arm nearer the viewer; the body behind it, the horned helm in profile, the tassets and the mace show clearly.
- REAR THREE-QUARTER and BACK: the knight's back is open: the back plates, the backs of the pauldrons, the helm's back with its horns. Only the shield's rim and the straps on its inside show at the side.

LAYOUT
- One horizontal row of 5 equal cells, read left to right: FRONT (facing the viewer), FRONT THREE-QUARTER, SIDE (profile), REAR THREE-QUARTER, BACK (facing away).
- In the front three-quarter, side and rear three-quarter views the knight faces IMAGE-LEFT.
- The shield stays on the same arm (the left) and the mace in the same hand (the right) in every view, so each is on the opposite side of the body in the front and back views.
- The same figure at the same scale in every cell, standing on the same ground line, in the same pose; only the camera angle changes.
- Background: flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, with no gradient, texture, vignette, glow, cast shadow or floor.
- The cells are separated by thin vertical lines of pure cyan (#00FFFF), each running the full height of the image.
- The whole figure, including the horns, the shield's top and the mace, fits inside each cell with a clear magenta margin. Nothing touches a cell edge or a cyan line, and nothing is cropped.
- No text, labels, numbers, frame borders, sparks, smoke or effects outside the figure. The glow of the eyes and runes stays on the armour and shield, never as a halo on the magenta.
- Crisp pixel art with hard edges and no anti-aliasing against the magenta. No semi-transparent pixels, and no pink or purple glow bleeding into the background.
